run_benchmark_cli: run the benchmark CLI with a dataset path and model to execute agent scenarios
run_gaia2_evaluation: run the gaia2-run command to execute a complete GAIA2 evaluation pipeline with judge model
generate_benchmark_reports: generate and save validation and JSON stats reports from benchmark results to an output directory
validate_scenario_sources: validate benchmark scenario source parameters to ensure exactly one dataset source is specified
run_offline_judge: run the judge command to perform offline validation of previously executed benchmark scenarios
